verses.1: And I will see, and behold, there is a sky above the clouds, like a sheet of slate. It looks like a shadowy image, as if it were visible above them.
verses.2: And he said to the man, “Go and gather the dust from beneath the thorns.” He also said, “Go and throw it on the city.” And he brought it before my eyes.
verses.3: And the cherubim stand on either side of the house, as soon as the man enters. The cloud fills up the inner courtyard.
verses.4: And the glory of Jehovah was raised above the roof of the house. The house was filled with clouds, and the courtyard was filled with smoke. It was a sign of Jehovah’s glory.
verses.5: And the sound of the wings of the swallows could be heard even outside the outer courtyard, like the sound of an angel speaking.
verses.6: And in his command, he told the man to take fire from between the two branches, and then bring it to the altar. He then went and stood beside the altar.
verses.7: And the cherubim sent its hand from between them to the cherubims near the fire. It took something from there and gave it to the flames of the burning wood. Then it took it away.
verses.8: And the ravens saw a human hand under their wings.
verses.9: And I see that there are four columns along each side of the columns. One column is located at one end of each side, and another column is located at the other end of each side. The appearance of these columns resembles that of a stone pillar.
verses.10: And in their appearance, each one resembles the others four times over, as the situation becomes more complex within that situation.
verses.11: As they walk towards the four corners of their territory, they shall not turn around during their journey. For the place where they will face is located behind them; they must continue walking without turning around.
verses.12: And all their bodies, their heads, their hands, their wings, and their faces are covered with eyes all around them.
verses.13: Their names were called “Galgal” in my ears.
verses.14: And there are four faces to each face of the one face. The first face is the face of the cow; the second face is the face of a human being; the third face is the face of an animal; and the fourth face is the face of a warrior.
verses.15: And the worms were the life that I saw in the river Kavbar.
verses.16: And when the locusts go forth, the locusts will go with them. And when they spread their wings over the ground, the locusts will not be able to get away from them either.
verses.17: They shall stand there, and in their hearts they will cry out, for the spirit of life dwells within them.
verses.18: And the glory of the LORD came down from above the heavens, and he stood on the cherubims.
verses.19: And the cherubim raised their wings and flew from the earth before their eyes. They faced towards their destination. Then, the door of the Holy Temple was opened, and the glory of the LORD of Israel was revealed to them from above.
verses.20: It was the life that I saw under the gods of Israel, in the river Kebar. And I know that there are many who are like that.
verses.21: Four faces for one, and four wings for one. Their appearance resembles human hands beneath their wings.
verses.22: And the appearance of their faces was such that I saw those faces on the banks of the Kavir River. And those faces were so beautiful that people could not bear to look at them directly.
